findings.defect: The quotation marks turn Taekyung’s internal reaction into dialogue spoken aloud, adding an action absent from the source.
findings.rationale: The Korean is unquoted internal narration, continuing Taekyung’s private reaction to the Sword Saint’s claim.

findings.current: Even with advanced First Rate martial arts and internal energy, anyone without the enlightenment to match them would spend their entire life taking one step forward and one step back.
findings.defect: The draft replaces remaining stuck in place with a repeated forward-and-back action and omits that this is another fact Taekyung knows.
findings.rationale: 제자리걸음 means making no progress or remaining at the same level, while 것도 continues the preceding statement about what Taekyung knows.
findings.replacement: I also knew that even with advanced First Rate martial arts and internal energy, anyone without the enlightenment to match would spend their entire life stuck in place.
findings.source: 초일류의 무공과 공력을 갖춰도 그에 걸맞은 깨달음이 없다면 평생을 제자리걸음만 반복해야 한다는 것도.

findings.defect: “Impressive” adds praise or sarcasm not present in the source and weakens the short, deadpan reaction to Cheongpung’s misunderstanding.
findings.rationale: The Korean simply remarks in disbelief that Cheongpung has interpreted Hyuk Mujin’s flight as evidence of successful training.
findings.replacement: So that was how he interpreted it.

findings.current: Cheongpung continued with a mischievous grin.
findings.defect: The draft assigns Cheongpung a mischievous intent instead of preserving his audible, childlike giggle.
findings.rationale: 히히 웃으며 explicitly describes giggling; it does not characterize the expression as calculating or mischievous.

summary: One line is incorrectly presented as spoken dialogue, and several localized choices alter the source’s meaning or comic tone.
